wishes.title: Classes for everyone
wishes.line: GutGr1nder wished for an RPG class system: Warrior, Ranger, Arcanist and Artificer, each with its own levels, a passive, an ability and a weakness. Opt-in, coming soon.

wishes.title: dvolic21: Shenron's Earthbreaker
wishes.line: dvolic21 asked Shenron for the ultimate pickaxe and received the Earthbreaker, a fully enchanted netherite pickaxe that mines a 5x5 area of stone.

wishes.title: ItsLogiks: the Merfolk
wishes.line: ItsLogiks asked Nuova Shenron to give the sea its own people: villagers he calls to the sea with a nautilus shell become Merfolk who never drown, with sea traders and kelp beds beneath the waves.

wishes.title: SirBepy's sea blessings
wishes.line: Porunga gave SirBepy Dolphin's Grace and Conduit Power he can call on, and a trident with Sharpness V, Impaling V, Loyalty III and Mending.

wishes.title: CoffiebagSupreme: the farmer's blessing
wishes.line: CoffiebagSupreme asked Nether Porunga for self-replanting crops, peace with zombies, husks and drowned until he strikes first, and food that fills twice as much.

wishes.title: Gifts of the sea
wishes.line: ItsLogiks asked Porunga for the sea: Dolphin's Grace and Conduit Power he can call up at will, and a Riptide trident to ride the rain.

wishes.title: The Adventurer's Guild
wishes.line: A server-wide guild with contracts and ranks from E to S that anyone can join with /guild. ImMijo is its Guildmaster.

wishes.title: Meaner phantoms
wishes.line: Skip sleep for 2 nights and they come, twice as often: bigger, faster, fireproof, and some are venomous.

wishes.title: The cartel flip phone
wishes.line: Archontopouloi can call the Salamanca cousins to guard him or to settle a score.

wishes.title: Haru, Keeper of the Sakura Sanctuary
wishes.line: A merchant at ImMijo's base. Anyone can buy his Everyday Wares; the rest of his shop is ImMijo's.
